drinks.name: The Painkiller
drinks.blurb: Cold-pressed mocha java espresso with dehydrated espresso crystals that linger after the last sip. The most scientific coffee on the South Coast.

drinks.name: The Aeroccino
drinks.blurb: Iced espresso whipped with the steam wand until the crema turns silky. No sugar. Almost no calories. Half & half, oat, or almond if you want it. Only at The Nook CoffeeHouse.

drinks.name: The Local Buzz
drinks.blurb: Costa Rican light roast cooked down into our coffee syrup. Tastes like coffee milk — honey, maple, almond, vanilla. The canvas for the flavors.

drinks.name: The Skooma
drinks.blurb: Three coffees — Local Buzz, cold-pressed espresso, and cold brew — blended frozen. Cup dressed in chocolate and caramel, topped with whipped cream. A dessert drink.

drinks.name: Chai Latte
drinks.blurb: Spiced tea blended with the milk of your choice. Hot or iced.

drinks.name: Hive Mind
drinks.blurb: Our signature cappuccino. Nettie’s Bees honey, a touch of vanilla, and two cinnamons — Indonesian coarse grind, perfumed into the milk.

drinks.name: Carnival Bazaar
drinks.blurb: Cotton candy frappe blended with ice and topped with Pop Rocks. For kids. For adults who still count.

drinks.name: Pistachio Matcha
drinks.blurb: Pistachio and matcha, hot or iced. A little green, a little nutty, not from a chain.

food.name: Linguiça Rolls
food.blurb: House dough stuffed with American cheese and thin-sliced linguica, finished with our Sea Salt Sprinkle. People drive for these.

food.name: Croissants
food.blurb: Hand-rolled every morning with Plugra butter. New Orleans French style — baked fresh, not pulled from a bag.

food.name: Cheese Rolls
food.blurb: House dough stuffed with American cheese, finished with our Sea Salt Sprinkle.

food.name: Buttermilk Biscuits
food.blurb: Made with our own cultured butter and the buttermilk that comes with it. Baked in-house every morning.

pizza.name: Cheese
pizza.blurb: Tomato sauce, cheddar–mozzarella blend, finished with our Sea Salt Sprinkle. The classic. Build from here if you want.

pizza.name: The Meatball Thing
pizza.blurb: Sliced meatballs, whipped ricotta, roasted garlic, and Nettie’s Bees hot honey. Sweet, savory, and the one people keep asking for.

pizza.name: Fire Flower
pizza.blurb: White pie, cheddar–mozzarella blend, chicken soaked in our house Fire Flower buffalo sauce. No tomato. Just heat.

pizza.name: Swineapple
pizza.blurb: Linguiça, bacon, and pineapple on tomato sauce. Sweet heat. Portuguese. Unapologetic.

pizza.name: Great Tots of Fire
pizza.blurb: Ground linguiça, banana peppers, tater tots, and Fireflower on the traditional crust. Spicy, crunchy, addictive — not a dare.
